# Municipal Ordinance No. 11, Series of 2022 -- Budget Augmentation (FY 2022)

**Resolution No. 364**

## Summary

Augments unexpended amounts from savings in the FY 2022 Annual and Supplemental Budget to cover insufficient expenditures in various municipal offices and personnel benefits. The total augmentation amounts to P2,807,273.81 from savings, plus P940,000.00 for personnel benefits. References Appropriation Ordinance No. 03, Series 2021 (CY 2022 Annual Budget). Enacted pursuant to [[Sec-336-RA7160]] on the use of appropriated funds and augmentation authority, and [[Sec-321-RA7160]] on changes in appropriation.

## Key Provisions

- Augments unexpended savings of P2,807,273.81 from FY 2022 Annual and Supplemental Budget
- Allocates additional P940,000.00 for personnel benefits
- Reallocates funds to insufficient object of expenditures across various municipal offices
- References Appropriation Ordinance No. 03, Series 2021 (CY 2022 Annual Budget) as the base appropriation
- Exercises augmentation authority per [[Sec-336-RA7160]]
- Complies with [[Sec-321-RA7160]] on changes in appropriation
